clips.send: A mom sends this to her stingy adult kid: proof that giving away 10% of a $1.50 paycheck built a $300 billion fortune - pure awe at the math.
clips.caption:
J.D. Rockefeller started his career on $1.50 a week - and gave 10% of it away immediately.

He kept that habit on every paycheck for the rest of his life, no matter how much he had.

Kevin Trudeau tells the story because Rockefeller said that single habit, not any deal he ever made, was the real secret to his fortune.

He died having given away the equivalent of $300 billion in today's money.

What's stopping you from giving away 10% starting with your next paycheck?
